title: MCTS-Judge: Test-Time Scaling in LLM-as-a-Judge for Code Correctness Evaluation
authors_zh: Yutong Wang；Pengliang Ji；Chaoqun Yang；Kaixin Li；Ming Hu；Jiaoyang Li；Guillaume Sartoretti
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: A test-time MCTS framework for code-correctness judging that exposes trajectory-aware self-assessment and unit-test-level reward as its feedback objects.
MCTS-Judge 将代码正确性判断分解为树搜索，结合历史动作自评、UCT 和单元测试级奖励机制形成测试时 LLM-as-a-Judge 轨迹。
why: It is an instructive high-risk trace source: MCTS trajectories, self-assessment, UCT values, and executable reward evidence must be preserved before LLM judging can be treated as reusable feedback.
inclusion_reason: It is an instructive high-risk trace source: MCTS trajectories, self-assessment, UCT values, and executable reward evidence must be preserved before LLM judging can be treated as reusable feedback.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code-correctness evaluation needs a binary decision about whether a candidate program implements a problem statement. Executing a comprehensive trusted test suite would provide a strong predicate, but private tests and a safe runtime may be unavailable; direct LLM-as-a-Judge prompts are then vulnerable to shallow analysis, bias, and misread program behavior. The paper asks whether additional test-time search can improve this judgment without training a new judge.

MCTS-Judge decomposes one judgment into a tree of perspective-specific evaluations and uses a fully LLM-driven simulated-execution signal to guide search. The track-relevant data object is a set of MCTS states, chosen subtask actions, textual analyses, binary sub-decisions, UCT statistics, self-assessment decisions, generated test cases, simulated execution traces, terminal rewards, and a final Yes/No judgment. This is evaluation-time feedback data, not a released training corpus. The official arXiv v2 paper is the confirmed primary artifact; no official code, generated-test database, trajectory dump, or executable environment was confirmed, and the paper's limitation section describes their release as future work.

代码正确性评估需要判断候选程序是否实现了题目要求。若能在安全运行环境中执行覆盖充分且可信的测试套件，就可获得较强判定条件；但私有测试和可执行环境可能不可用，此时直接使用 LLM-as-a-Judge 容易出现浅层分析、偏差和程序行为误读。论文的问题是：能否在不训练新 judge 的前提下，用更多测试时搜索提高这种判断。

MCTS-Judge 将一次判断拆成由多种评估视角构成的搜索树，并用完全由 LLM 驱动的 simulated-execution 信号引导搜索。本 Track 相关的数据对象包括 MCTS state、被选 subtask action、文本分析、二元子判定、UCT 统计、自评决策、生成测试用例、模拟执行轨迹、terminal reward 和最终 Yes/No 判断。这是 evaluation-time feedback data，并非已发布训练语料。已确认的主要 artifact 是官方 arXiv v2 论文；目前未确认官方代码、生成测试数据库、轨迹 dump 或可执行环境，且论文限制部分仍把这些内容的发布写为未来工作。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
A root contains the problem statement and candidate code. Actions select non-repeating evaluation subtasks, plus a null action; executing an action asks the base LLM for a perspective-specific analysis and binary decision. Selection combines global UCT from prior rollouts with an LLM self-assessment of whether the proposed subtask improves coverage of the current history. Expansion samples an unused action, simulation continues non-null actions to maximum depth, and a trajectory prediction aggregates its binary sub-decisions with a separate global evaluation.

The terminal signal is not actual program execution. Before search, GPT-4o generates input-output test cases from the problem statement and validates each case repeatedly. At a leaf, the search LLM receives a masked-output case and is prompted to act as an interpreter line by line; repeated simulated outputs vote on whether each case passes, and the simulated verifier declares the program correct only if all sampled cases pass. A trajectory receives reward when its judgment agrees with this simulated result. Compared with vanilla judging, majority voting, Best-of-N, or plain UCT, the contribution is the combination of multi-perspective MCTS, history-conditioned self-assessment, and a cross-checked but still judgment-required pseudo-execution reward.

根节点包含题目描述和候选代码。action 选择不重复的评估 subtask，另有一个 null action；执行 action 时，base LLM 生成特定视角的分析与二元决策。selection 把既有 rollout 的全局 UCT 与 LLM 对“候选 subtask 是否能改善当前历史覆盖度”的自评结合。expansion 随机采样未使用 action，simulation 继续选择非空 action 直至最大深度，最后把轨迹中的二元子判定与一次独立全局评价聚合为 trajectory prediction。

terminal signal 并不来自真实程序执行。搜索前，GPT-4o 根据题目生成 input-output test case，并重复验证每个 case。到达叶节点后，搜索 LLM 获得隐藏输出的测试输入，被要求逐行扮演解释器；多次模拟输出投票决定单个 case 是否通过，只有全部抽样 case 都通过时，模拟 verifier 才判程序正确。trajectory judgment 与该模拟结果一致时获得 reward。相较 vanilla judging、majority voting、Best-of-N 或纯 UCT，其贡献是把多视角 MCTS、基于历史的自评和经过交叉检查但仍需模型判断的伪执行 reward 组合起来。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are a programming problem p and candidate code c, optionally with examples or reference code depending on the evaluation condition. The reported benchmarks are HumanEval-X (164 tasks in five languages), 100 randomly selected competition-level APPS tasks, and BigCodeBench (1,140 Python tasks); five base models include Qwen2.5-Coder-14B, DeepSeek-Coder-V2-16B-Instruct, Codestral-22B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and GPT-4o-mini.

The main configuration uses tree depth 9, eight MCTS rollouts, UCT exploration constant 3, LLM/UCT selection weights 0.1/0.9, terminal reward 1.1, temperature 0.4, top-p 0.95, top-k 40, and maximum output 2,048 tokens. GPT-4o generates tests; each is validated five times. At a leaf, three stored tests are sampled and each simulated seven times. A majority determines each output, all selected cases must pass for h(x)=correct, and agreement between h(x) and the trajectory judgment supplies the terminal reward. Cumulative rewards guide weighted final-trajectory selection. BigCodeBench items without meaningful input-output pairs substitute simulated discussion signals.

The data needed for replay includes prompts, action inventory, tree topology, visit counts, Q values, UCT and self-assessment weights, every node analysis, test generation/validation attempts, sampled cases, seven execution simulations per case, aggregate decisions, reward propagation, and final sampling. None of these run-level records or a pinned implementation was confirmed as released; all experiments are reported on a single 80GB H100.

输入是编程题 p 与候选代码 c；根据评测条件，也可能提供示例或 reference code。论文使用 HumanEval-X（五种语言共 164 题）、随机抽取的 100 道 APPS competition-level 题，以及 BigCodeBench（1,140 道 Python 题）；五个 base model 包括 Qwen2.5-Coder-14B、DeepSeek-Coder-V2-16B-Instruct、Codestral-22B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 GPT-4o-mini。

主要配置为 tree depth 9、八次 MCTS rollout、UCT exploration constant 3、LLM/UCT selection weight 0.1/0.9、terminal reward 1.1、temperature 0.4、top-p 0.95、top-k 40 和最大输出 2,048 token。GPT-4o 生成测试，每个 case 重复验证五次；到叶节点后抽取三个已存测试，每个模拟执行七次。多数票决定单个输出，全部抽取 case 通过时 h(x) 才判为 correct；h(x) 与 trajectory judgment 一致即产生 terminal reward。累计 reward 用于加权选择最终轨迹。对缺少有意义 input-output pair 的 BigCodeBench 条目，方法改用 simulated discussion signal。

重放所需数据包括 prompt、action inventory、树结构、visit count、Q value、UCT 与自评权重、每个节点分析、测试生成/验证尝试、被抽 case、每个 case 的七次执行模拟、聚合决策、reward 回传和最终采样。当前未确认这些 run-level 记录或固定版本实现已发布；论文称所有实验在单张 80GB H100 上完成。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across the reported five base models and three benchmarks, MCTS-Judge generally improves over the corresponding vanilla and System-1 judge baselines. The headline APPS example raises DeepSeek-Coder-V2-16B-Instruct judgment accuracy from 41.0% to 80.0%; the ablation attributes 13 points to replacing weaker MCTS rewards with the simulated-execution reward and another two points to adding LLM self-assessment over UCT alone. Scaling plots vary the number of tests, simulations, depth, and rollouts and show gains that depend on the model and axis. The paper also evaluates judging without reference code and uses an LLM panel to rate trajectory qualities.

These findings support the claim that the proposed search-and-pseudo-execution procedure can improve code-judgment accuracy under the studied protocol. They do not validate the generated tests or simulated executions as ground truth. GPT-4o creates the expected outputs, while another LLM imitates execution; correlated errors can therefore reward an incorrect trajectory. Accuracy gains and LLM-rated reasoning quality are not proof that the unreleased trajectory data is complete, unbiased, or suitable for training.

在论文报告的五个 base model 和三个 benchmark 上，MCTS-Judge 通常优于对应 vanilla 与 System-1 judge baseline。代表性 APPS 结果把 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-16B-Instruct 的判断准确率从 41.0% 提高到 80.0%；ablation 显示，用 simulated-execution reward 替换较弱的 MCTS reward 带来 13 个百分点，纯 UCT 再加入 LLM 自评带来 2 个百分点。缩放实验分别改变测试数量、模拟次数、深度与 rollout 数，增益会随模型和缩放轴变化。论文还评估了无 reference code 条件，并用 LLM panel 评价轨迹质量。

这些结果支持“所研究协议下，搜索与伪执行流程可提高代码判断准确率”的主张，但不能把生成测试或模拟执行视为 ground truth。预期输出由 GPT-4o 生成，另一个 LLM 再模仿执行，相关性错误可能奖励错误轨迹。准确率提升与 LLM 对推理质量的评分也不能证明未发布轨迹数据完整、无偏或适合训练。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Direct LLM judges produce one holistic answer; majority-vote baselines execute a fixed set of perspectives; ordinary MCTS commonly uses UCT and a learned or self-evaluation reward. MCTS-Judge makes the action space a set of code-review perspectives, adds a local history-conditioned LLM gate to global UCT, and constructs a terminal signal through generated tests plus repeated line-by-line simulated execution. This differs from execution-based verification because no candidate code is actually run in the stated reward mechanism.

For the atlas, the direction signal is that judge search produces reusable state-action and trajectory-value objects only if the complete tree and reward provenance are preserved. The test-generation and simulated-execution branches are especially important because the reward's apparent precision depends on them. MCTS, UCT, generated unit tests, majority voting, and LLM self-assessment are established components; novelty lies in their task-specific assembly for test-time code judging. Benchmark gains should not be converted into a blanket quality label for intermediate analyses, generated cases, or reward values.

直接 LLM judge 只生成一次整体判断；majority-vote baseline 执行固定视角集合；普通 MCTS 常用 UCT 以及 learned/self-evaluation reward。MCTS-Judge 把 action space 设为一组代码审查视角，在全局 UCT 之外增加基于当前历史的局部 LLM gate，并通过生成测试与重复逐行模拟执行构造 terminal signal。它不同于 execution-based verification，因为论文所述 reward mechanism 并未真正运行候选代码。

对本 Atlas 而言，方向信号是：只有完整保留搜索树与 reward provenance，judge search 产生的 state-action 和 trajectory-value 才能复用。测试生成与模拟执行分支尤为关键，因为 reward 的表面精度依赖这些步骤。MCTS、UCT、生成 unit test、majority voting 与 LLM self-assessment 都是已有组件；新意在于面向测试时代码判断的任务化组合。不能把 benchmark 提升转成对中间分析、生成 case 或 reward value 的统一质量标签。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The verifier is fully LLM driven: GPT-4o generates and validates expected outputs, and the search model simulates execution rather than running code. Shared model biases, arithmetic mistakes, unsupported language behavior, malformed tests, and false expected outputs can become self-confirming rewards. Requiring all sampled tests to pass is asymmetric but does not remove false positives when the tests miss a bug. For some BigCodeBench tasks the method falls back to simulated discussions, weakening the already non-executable predicate.

The APPS experiment uses a random 100-task competition subset, but the immutable item list and seeds were not confirmed. Search cost depends on prompts, proprietary GPT-4o behavior, and eight-rollout stochasticity. The paper acknowledges reliance on GPT-4o and promises code, the test-case data flywheel, and documentation upon acceptance; no official release was confirmed. Raw trees, failed cases, reward records, reference-use flags, exact model endpoints, licenses for generated artifacts, and contamination controls remain unknown. LLM-panel trajectory ratings add another judge layer rather than human ground truth.

verifier 完全由 LLM 驱动：GPT-4o 生成并验证预期输出，搜索模型模拟执行而不真正运行代码。共享模型偏差、算术错误、语言支持不足、畸形测试和错误预期输出都可能变成自我确认的 reward。要求全部抽样测试通过虽具有不对称性，但当测试遗漏 bug 时仍不能消除 false positive。对部分 BigCodeBench 任务，方法退回 simulated discussion，使原本就不可执行的判定更弱。

APPS 实验随机使用 100 道 competition 子集，但未确认不可变 item list 与随机种子。搜索成本依赖 prompt、专有 GPT-4o 行为及八次 rollout 的随机性。论文承认对 GPT-4o 的依赖，并承诺在接收后发布代码、test-case data flywheel 与文档；目前未确认官方发布。原始搜索树、失败 case、reward 记录、reference-use 标记、精确模型 endpoint、生成 artifact 许可证和污染控制均未知。由 LLM panel 给出的轨迹评分只是增加了一层 judge，并非人工 ground truth。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the rollout/search/test-time trace track, a reusable MCTS-Judge record should preserve the problem and candidate code; benchmark item and reference availability; model/version and full prompts; action inventory; parent-child edges; node analysis and binary sub-decision; visit count, Q, UCT, local self-assessment, and selection probability; generated test cases and all validation attempts; sampled cases; each simulated variable trace and predicted output; per-case vote; h(x); trajectory aggregate; terminal reward; backpropagation; and final trajectory choice.

This schema would enable auditing reward leakage, self-confirmation, action coverage, and whether more test-time compute helps because of broader analysis or repeated correlated judgments. It could also support judge or verifier research, but only after separating actual execution results from simulated outputs and keeping hidden benchmark labels out of search. Without the official tree and test-case release, the paper currently supplies a recipe and risk model rather than a reusable feedback dataset.

对 rollout/search/test-time trace Track，可复用的 MCTS-Judge 记录应保存：题目与候选代码、benchmark item 与 reference 可用性、模型/version 和完整 prompt、action inventory、父子边、节点分析与二元子判定、visit count/Q/UCT/局部自评/选择概率、生成测试及全部验证尝试、被抽 case、每次模拟的变量轨迹与预测输出、单 case 投票、h(x)、trajectory aggregate、terminal reward、backpropagation 和最终轨迹选择。

该 schema 可用于审计 reward leakage、自我确认、action coverage，以及增加测试时算力究竟来自更广分析还是重复相关判断。它也可支持 judge/verifier 研究，但必须把真实执行结果与模拟输出分开，并确保隐藏 benchmark label 不进入搜索。由于官方树与测试 case 尚未发布，目前论文提供的是 recipe 与风险模型，而不是可复用反馈数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• MCTS actions are perspective-specific code-evaluation subtasks plus a null action.
  • Node selection blends UCT with an LLM assessment of the current trajectory history.
  • The reward uses GPT-4o-generated tests and repeated LLM-simulated execution, not actual code execution.
  • Main settings are depth 9, eight rollouts, three sampled tests, and seven simulations per test.
  • The paper promises a future code/data-flywheel release; no official trace artifact was confirmed.

• MCTS action 是特定代码评估视角的 subtask，并包含 null action。
  • 节点选择把 UCT 与 LLM 对当前 trajectory history 的自评结合。
  • reward 使用 GPT-4o 生成测试和重复 LLM 模拟执行，而非真实代码执行。
  • 主要设置为深度 9、八次 rollout、三个抽样测试和每测试七次模拟。
  • 论文承诺未来发布代码与 data-flywheel；当前未确认官方轨迹 artifact。
